summary.shortDescription: The original full-size ProVari, a single-cell variable-voltage regulated tube mod introduced in 2010.
summary.description: The first-generation ProVari adjusts output voltage from 3.3 to 6.0 V and predates the lower-resistance V2 electronics and the smaller ProVari Mini.
highlights: Single 18490/18500 cell, or single 18650 with extension cap
